items.name: layered-panel
items.title: Layered Panel
items.description: Right-hand peek panel that expands in place to a two-column detail view. No route change. Optional Next.js URL sync keeps Back working: full collapses to peek, then closes. Ships no theme, cssVars, or global CSS — it uses the host project's shadcn tokens and primitives.
items.author: Eduardo Retana

meta.descriptionEs: Panel de detalle que se abre a la derecha y crece en el mismo lugar hasta dos columnas. La ruta no cambia, así que la tabla conserva el scroll.

examples.title: Directorio del equipo
examples.description: Tabla densa. Un clic abre el peek y otro expande el perfil.

examples.title: Lead de CRM
examples.description: La misma pieza con etiquetas en español.

meta.usage:
Record

api.name: open
api.description: Controlled open state.

api.name: onOpenChange
api.description: Called when the dialog asks to open or close.

api.name: mode
api.description: Controlled disclosure mode.

api.name: onModeChange
api.description: Called when the panel switches between peek and full.

api.name: peekWidth
api.description: Desktop peek width. Any single CSS length. Default 26.25rem.

api.name: fullWidth
api.description: Desktop expanded width. Default 70vw.

api.name: closeLabel
api.description: Accessible name of the close button. Default Close.

api.name: mobilePeekLabel / mobileFullLabel
api.description: Tab labels below 1024px. Defaults Overview and Profile.

api.name: className and slot classes
api.description: overlayClassName, closeClassName, tabsClassName, tabClassName, gridClassName, plus className on every compound part.

api.name: LayeredPanel.Peek / Full
api.description: Peek stays on the right. Full is the left column and stays hidden until mode is full.

api.name: LayeredPanel.ExpandToggle
api.description: expandLabel and collapseLabel. Defaults View full profile and Close profile.

api.name: DetailSection / DetailField
api.description: Uppercase section label and a field row with optional icon, value, and href.

api.name: useLayeredPanelUrlState
api.description: Optional Next.js hook. ?member=id opens peek. &view=full expands. Back collapses, then closes.

items.docs: Import LayeredPanel from the installed UI file. URL sync is a separate hook (use-layered-panel-url-state) and is the only file that imports next/navigation. Below 1024px the panel is a full-screen sheet with tabs. The item declares button, scroll-area, and separator as registryDependencies and does not vendor copies. Answer no if the CLI asks to overwrite those files. No cssVars.

items.name: chat-message
items.title: Chat Message
items.description: Message bubble for a person or an assistant, with avatar, time, sending and error states, and copy, retry, and regenerate actions.
items.author: Eduardo Retana

meta.descriptionEs: Burbuja de mensaje para la persona o el asistente, con avatar, hora, estados de envío y error, y acciones de copiar, reintentar y regenerar.

api.name: role
api.description: Which side and tone to use.

api.name: status
api.description: Delivery state. Default sent.

api.name: onRetry / onRegenerate / onCopy
api.description: Optional actions. Copy uses copyText or the text content.

api.name: labels

items.name: chat-composer
items.title: Chat Composer
items.description: Growing textarea that sends on Enter, inserts a newline on Shift+Enter, accepts attachments, swaps in a stop button while generating, and leaves a slot for a model picker.

meta.descriptionEs: Área de texto que crece, envía con Enter, inserta un salto con Mayús+Enter, admite adjuntos, muestra detener mientras se genera y reserva un hueco para el modelo.

items.name: streaming-text
items.title: Streaming Text
items.description: Renders text as it arrives, with a caret and a short fade-in, and supports basic markdown.
items.author: Eduardo Retana

meta.descriptionEs: Pinta el texto a medida que llega, con cursor y una aparición breve, y entiende markdown básico.

examples.title: Texto en streaming
examples.description: Pinta el texto a medida que llega, con cursor y una aparición breve, y entiende markdown básico.

api.name: text
api.description: Full text received so far.

api.name: streaming
api.description: Keeps the caret visible.

api.name: animate
api.description: Reveal gradually. Default true. Set false to paint the whole string.

api.name: cursorLabel
api.description: Screen-reader label while generating. Default Generating.

items.docs: Headings, lists, bold, italic, inline code, and http(s) or mailto links are rendered as elements. Other URLs stay text. No theme is shipped.
